title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are buzzing with activity as companies seek to scale operations and secure funding. Meanwhile, government budgets and international collaborations are shaping the landscape for future projects.

themes.title: Scaling Up Operations
themes.body: Astrobotic's sale to Voyager is a clear signal that scaling is the name of the game in the lunar lander market. Similarly, Northrop Grumman's push for solid rocket production indicates a readiness to meet increasing demand.

themes.title: Funding Frenzy
themes.body: ElevationSpace's recent Series B funding round highlights the ongoing appetite for investment in the space sector, with a total of $63.5 million raised. True Anomaly's $190 million Series C also underscores the trend of substantial capital flowing into space startups.

themes.title: Strategic Partnerships
themes.body: Anduril and L3Harris teaming up for a tactical SDA constellation bid reflects the growing trend of collaboration in the defense tech space. MDA Space's acquisition of Blue Canyon Technologies further emphasizes the importance of strategic moves to gain market footholds.

themes.title: Government Influence
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adding $1.4 billion to space resilience suggests that government priorities are shifting towards bolstering national security in space. This trend is likely to influence private sector strategies as they align with public funding initiatives.
